autocreatepage-recursion-exceeded: Error message shown in place of the parser function output when the configured recursion depth ($egAutoCreatePageMaxRecursion) has been exceeded.
autocreatepage-empty-title: Error message shown in place of the parser function output when no title was given and $egAutoCreatePageIgnoreEmptyTitle is false.
autocreatepage-edit-comment:
Edit summary used for pages created by the extension. Parameters:
* $1 - the prefixed title of the page that triggered the creation, wrapped in wikilink syntax by the caller
